classes.name: Algebra 1
classes.verification: Identified in student-specific FCPS progress correspondence; verify current section assignment in SIS.

grading_policy.reassessment: One summative retake after required remediation and homework; replacement capped at 90%, higher attempt kept. Flex retakes generally occur around two weeks after the assessment.
grading_policy.late_work: Work generally accepted before its related retake (roughly two weeks). Formative remediation is generally within two weeks; late formative work may receive zero.

classes.name: English 9 Honors
classes.verification: Student-specific Schoology summary identifies 'Mohan, P' for period 2; 2026–27 departmental syllabus identifies Patrick Mohan and school email. Reconfirm in SIS.

grading_policy.weights: Rolling gradebook; no separate category percentages specified in the reviewed syllabus.
grading_policy.reassessment: One summative reassessment, capped at 90%, with the higher attempt retained. Remediation within two weeks of receiving the graded assessment; follow the teacher's posted schedule.
grading_policy.late_work: Summative work accepted within two weeks with a 10% late penalty. The syllabus states that formative work submitted late receives zero.

classes.name: World History/Geography 2
classes.verification: Period 3 from prior student-specific records. The 2026–27 World History II syllabus lists five department contacts; it does not identify the assigned teacher for this section.

grading_policy.weights: Rolling gradebook; category percentages not specified in the reviewed syllabus.
grading_policy.reassessment: Multiple summative reassessment opportunities with remediation; reassessment scores capped at 90%, higher attempt retained.
grading_policy.late_work: Summative and formative work accepted up to two weeks late with a 10% penalty; unsubmitted work recorded as 0%. Verify that the department syllabus applies to this exact section.

classes.name: Marketing 1
classes.verification: Identified in student-specific FCPS progress correspondence and the 2026–27 course syllabus; verify current section assignment in SIS.

grading_policy.weights: Rolling gradebook; later demonstrated mastery may replace an earlier major-assessment score, including across quarters.
grading_policy.reassessment: One summative reassessment, capped at 90%, higher attempt kept. Teacher sets remediation deadline; group-project remediation may be individual.
grading_policy.late_work: All assignments accepted up to two weeks after the due date with a 10% late penalty; unsubmitted work recorded as 0%.

classes.name: Biology 1
classes.verification: Student-specific Schoology summary identifies 'Camire, A' for period 6; 2026–27 departmental syllabus identifies Amy Camire and school email. Reconfirm in SIS.

grading_policy.weights: Rolling gradebook; category percentages not specified in the reviewed syllabus.
grading_policy.reassessment: One summative reassessment, capped at 90%, higher attempt kept; remediation paper required and retake must be completed before the close of the same quarter.
grading_policy.late_work: Summative late work accepted within two weeks. The written syllabus specifies 50% for unsubmitted assignments; confirm actual gradebook entries in SIS rather than assuming a guaranteed grade floor.

classes.name: Photography 1
classes.verification: Student-specific Schoology summary identifies 'Kahnell, A' for period 7; 2026–27 departmental syllabus identifies Amanda Kahnell and school email. Reconfirm in SIS.

grading_policy.weights: Formative studio/artmaking 30%; summative portfolio and projects 70%.
grading_policy.reassessment: Previously submitted summative projects can be revised and resubmitted during the year. Studio participation cannot be made up; clarify any generic retake language with the teacher.
grading_policy.late_work: Missing work is due by the end of its quarter, with a 10% late penalty; unsubmitted formative work becomes NLA after quarter-end. Paper and ongoing portfolio items need status confirmation.

classes.name: Health & PE 9
classes.verification: Student-specific Schoology summary identifies 'Rozmiarek, D' for period 8; 2026–27 departmental syllabus identifies Dave Rozmiarek and school email. Reconfirm in SIS.

grading_policy.weights: Rolling gradebook; weekly PE work includes movement, safety/rules, and social interaction.
grading_policy.reassessment: One summative reassessment, capped at 90%, higher attempt retained.
grading_policy.late_work: Summative late work accepted within two weeks with a 10% penalty; formative late work is teacher-dependent. Excused PE absences have a separate one-hour activity form, generally due within a week and ordinarily limited to two per quarter; exceptions are individualized.
